title: Every Korean mom packs THIS box 📦😭
description:
2 a.m. in Seoul. A mom packs a box for her daughter's first winter abroad: kimchi, side dishes, ramyeon, hand-knitted socks... and one little note.

Korean moms don't say "I love you." They pack it.

Tag someone who still gets a box from Mom 💛
In Korea, the magpie is the bird that brings good news 🐦

#KoreanMom #Kimchi #StudyAbroad #Korea #KoreanCulture #shorts
pinned: What was in YOUR mom's box? 📦 Tell Kachi in the comments 💛
